answer: Every agent’s receipt claims a seat on a tundra atlas that collapses after 1.5 s of idle—settling is deterministic, so fakes must recompute the atlas caption for each identity from memory. Each caption takes 1.5 s to sketch in the canyon walls, and the walls auto-shuffle after each stroke; farms can’t template the strokes—injecting a fake costs 1.5 s of idle reset time per head.
